entries.name: Ashton Dulin
entries.summary: Dulin (ankle) is listed as out for Sunday's game against the Chiefs, Kevin Bowen of 107.5 The Fan Indianapolis reports.

entries.name: Chig Okonkwo
entries.summary: Okonkwo (hamstring) won't play Sunday at Dallas, Tashan Reed of The Athletic reports.

entries.name: De'Zhaun Stribling
entries.summary: The 49ers are expected to place Stribling (ankle) on injured reserve, Adam Schefter of ESPN.com reports.

entries.name: Jauan Jennings
entries.summary: Jennings (not injury related - personal) won't play Sunday in Chicago.

entries.name: Kene Nwangwu
entries.summary: Nwangwu (back) won't play in Sunday's game against the Packers, Zack Rosenblatt of The Athletic reports.

entries.name: Kyler Murray
entries.summary: Murray (concussion) won't play in Sunday's contest at Chicago.

entries.name: Marvin Mims Jr.
entries.summary: Mims (foot) has been ruled out for Sunday's game against the Jaguars, Troy Renck of Denver 7 News reports.

entries.name: Michael Penix Jr.
entries.summary: Penix (knee) won't play in Sunday's game against the Panthers, Will McFadden of the Falcons' official site reports.

entries.name: Nico Collins
entries.summary: Collins (hamstring) will not play Sunday against the Bengals.

entries.name: Omar Cooper Jr.
entries.summary: Cooper (ankle) will not play Sunday against the Packers, Zack Rosenblatt of The Athletic reports.

entries.name: Sam Darnold
entries.summary: Coach Mike Macdonald said Darnold (glute) won't play in Sunday's game at Arizona, Curtis Crabtree of Fox 13 Seattle reports.

entries.name: Skyler Bell
entries.summary: Bell (coach's decision) is inactive for Thursday's game versus Detroit.

entries.name: Ty Johnson
entries.summary: Johnson (hamstring) is listed as inactive Thursday against the Lions.

entries.name: Zach Charbonnet
entries.summary: Coach Mike Macdonald said Friday that the Seahawks are drawing closer to setting a date for Charbonnet (knee) to resume practicing, Gregg Bell of The Tacoma News Tribune reports.

entries.name: Brock Bowers
entries.summary: Bowers (knee) will be listed as doubtful for Sunday's game at the Chargers, and Raiders coach Klint Kubiak said Friday that the tight end will be worked out pregame before a final decision is made, Sam Warren of The Athletic reports.

entries.name: Tua Tagovailoa
entries.summary: Tagovailoa (oblique) is doubtful for Sunday's game versus the Panthers, Will McFadden of the Falcons' official site reports.

entries.name: Zay Flowers
entries.summary: Flowers (hamstring) is listed as doubtful for Sunday's game against New Orleans.

entries.name: Aidan O'Connell
entries.summary: O'Connell is listed as questionable for Sunday's game against the Chargers due to personal reasons.

entries.name: Chris Olave
entries.summary: Olave (hamstring) is listed as questionable for Sunday's game at Baltimore, Nick Underhill of NewOrleans.Football reports.

entries.name: DJ Giddens
entries.summary: Giddens (knee) is listed as questionable for Sunday's game against the Chiefs.

entries.name: DJ Moore
entries.summary: Moore (shoulder) is believed to have sustained an AC joint sprain in Thursday's victory over the Lions, and although "it's not a serious injury" he is uncertain for Week 3., Ian Rapoport of NFL Network reports.

entries.name: Jalen McMillan
entries.summary: McMillan (knee) is listed as questionable for Sunday's game against the Browns.

entries.name: Joe Burrow
entries.summary: Burrow (back) is listed as questionable for Sunday's game at Houston, but Bengals coach Zac Taylor said Friday that the quarterback is good to go, Paul Dehner Jr. of The Athletic reports.

entries.name: Jordan Whittington
entries.summary: Whittington (quadriceps) did not practice Friday.

entries.name: Kaelon Black
entries.summary: Black (groin) is listed as questionable for Sunday's game against the Dolphins, Cam Inman of The San Jose Mercury News reports.

entries.name: Ladd McConkey
entries.summary: McConkey (rib) is listed as questionable for Sunday's game against the Raiders, ESPN's Kris Rhim reports.

entries.name: Michael Pittman Jr.
entries.summary: Pittman (foot) is listed as questionable for Sunday's game against the Patriots, Brooke Pryor of ESPN.com reports.

entries.name: Puka Nacua
entries.summary: Nacua didn't practice Friday due to a hip injury, Benjamin Royer of The Orange County Register reports.

entries.name: RJ Harvey
entries.summary: Harvey (hamstring) is listed as questionable for Sunday's game against the Jaguars after he was limited in practice Friday for the second consecutive day.

entries.name: A.J. Brown
entries.summary: Brown, who was officially placed on injured reserve Saturday, is expected to miss about six weeks due to a right high-ankle sprain, Ian Rapoport of NFL Network reports.

entries.name: Audric Estime
entries.summary: The Saints placed Estime (thigh) on injured reserve Saturday, Ross Jackson of WWL Louisiana reports.

entries.name: Caleb Lohner
entries.summary: Lohner (lower body) was placed on injured reserve by the Broncos on Sunday with a designation to return, Aric DiLalla of the team's official website reports.

entries.name: D.J. Montgomery
entries.summary: Montgomery (abdomen) was placed on injured reserve by the Colts on Sunday, JJ Stankevitz of the team's official website reports.

entries.name: David Sills
entries.summary: Sills (undisclosed) was placed on injured reserve by the Buccaneers on Sunday with a designation to return, Scott Smith of the team's official website reports.

entries.name: Dillon Gabriel
entries.summary: ir

entries.name: Dylan Sampson
entries.summary: Sampson (knee) was placed on injured reserve Tuesday.

entries.name: Eli Stowers
entries.summary: The Eagles placed Stowers (quadriceps/hamstring) on injured reserve Saturday.

entries.name: Ja'Kobi Lane
entries.summary: Coach Jesse Minter said Lane underwent wrist surgery Wednesday, and the Ravens placed the rookie wide receiver on injured reserve, Brian Wacker of The Baltimore Sun reports.

entries.name: Jake Tonges
entries.summary: Tonges (knee) requires surgery for an MCL tear and is done for the season, Cam Inman reports.

entries.name: Jimmy Holiday
entries.summary: Holiday (undisclosed) was placed on injured reserve by the Chiefs on Sunday.

entries.name: Jordan Mason
entries.summary: ir

entries.name: KeAndre Lambert-Smith
entries.summary: The Chargers placed Lambert-Smith (hamstring) on injured reserve Tuesday.

entries.name: Malik Davis
entries.summary: The Cowboys placed Davis (hip) on injured reserve Saturday, Adam Schefter of ESPN reports.

entries.name: Tim Patrick
entries.summary: The Jets placed Patrick (groin) on injured reserve Saturday, Zack Rosenblatt of The Athletic reports.

entries.name: Will Mallory
entries.summary: Mallory (thumb) was placed on injured reserve by the Colts on Sunday with a designation to return, JJ Stankevitz of the team's official website reports.
